cases.name: answer-first
expect: opens with the answer in one to three sentences
no narration of what the agent did to find out

cases.name: only-actionable-sections
cases.prompt: Ship the retry fix and tell me where it stands.
expect: body limited to decisions, risks, and checks
risks names what could regress or says none known
checks names what ran and what did not

cases.name: no-unrequested-code
cases.prompt: Add a timeout to the client and report back.
expect: names the file and what changed
does not paste the function body
shows code only if the follow-up asks for it

cases.name: italic-labels
cases.prompt: Tell me where the retry fix stands, with decisions, risks, and checks.
expect: section labels are italic, as in *Decisions:*
labels are never bold, never a heading, never inline code
the first non-label emphasis is the next opener in the rotation, not a label

cases.name: jargon-once
cases.prompt: Why did the deploy fail on SCP?
expect: expands SCP once with a short content reminder
keeps the tradeoff or gotcha instead of dropping it for brevity
